en.title: 5 Thrillers Like The Runner To Stream Right Now
en.summary: Gal Gadot's high-octane chase thriller 'The Runner' is a hit, and we've got five more pulse-pounding films that capture its frantic energy.
en.body:
## 1. The Running Man (1987)
If you're drawn to the desperate fight for survival against overwhelming odds in 'The Runner,' then Arnold Schwarzenegger's iconic dystopian actioner is a must-see. Based on Stephen King's novel, it throws an innocent man into a deadly televised game show where he must fight for his life, offering a similar blend of high stakes and societal commentary.

## 2. The Long Walk (Upcoming)
While 'The Runner' features a race against time, 'The Long Walk' takes that concept to an extreme, embodying the spirit of relentless endurance. This adaptation of Stephen King's chilling novel (under the pseudonym Richard Bachman) depicts a grueling walking competition where contestants face elimination if they slow down, mirroring the life-or-death urgency of 'The Runner'.

## 3. Taken (2008)
Gal Gadot's character in 'The Runner' is a powerful attorney racing to save her child. Liam Neeson's Bryan Mills in 'Taken' is a retired operative doing the same, showcasing a father's fierce determination. This film's raw, no-nonsense approach to a parent's desperate rescue mission shares the urgent, personal stakes that make 'The Runner' so compelling.

## 4. Ransom (1996)
When a wealthy airline magnate's son is kidnapped, he turns the tables on the abductors by offering a hefty reward for his safe return, creating a tense, unpredictable game of cat and mouse. Much like 'The Runner,' where the protagonist is manipulated by a mysterious caller, 'Ransom' explores the psychological warfare and high-stakes negotiations involved in a child abduction scenario, with Mel Gibson delivering a powerhouse performance.

## 5. Nick of Time (1995)
Johnny Depp stars as a locksmith caught in a deadly political conspiracy who must assassinate the President to save his kidnapped daughter. This tightly wound thriller delivers the kind of frantic, ticking-clock tension that fans of 'The Runner' will appreciate, as the protagonist is forced into impossible choices under extreme duress, with every second counting.
Bottom Line: These five films deliver the adrenaline-fueled, high-stakes thrills that make 'The Runner' such a compelling watch.
